The parenthetical “sauf erreur” is visible surviving text and already appears in the original LaTeX.
rows.note: Preserve the author’s written order 1 and his qualification “sauf erreur”. The supplied correction table proposes order 1/alpha and genus 0, and points to a computation on 114. That mathematical correction is carried with attribution only; the pointed-to page was not read, and no exponent-of-convergence or order computation was checked.
